correctness.rationale: Affine symmetry reduces all singleton and two-sensor sets to explicitly checked representatives; all 68 minimum placements are nonedges. Both standalone checkers reconstruct a 68-row root distance certificate, one via direct exhaustive propagation and 2278 all-pairs shortest paths, the other via residue orbits and operator adjacency. The full finite graph is exhaustively checked; no extrapolation to larger graphs is made. Main residual risk is correlated implementation oversight, mitigated by independent constructions and a checkable certificate.

value.rationale: The Paley graph on 17 vertices is a natural small symmetric graph important in extremal graph theory. Identifying the entire feasible sensor class with nonedges, the Gallai relocation operator, and a sharp exact locality penalty (204 unrestricted transitions lost but unchanged diameter, 1020 endpoint pairs delayed by exactly one slide) gives a motivated, reusable finite benchmark for constrained sensor relocation. This is not merely the known Gallai regularity count.
